objects.name: Detection technique coverage: azure-ad-concurrent-sessions-from-different-ips
objects.description: The following analytic detects an Azure AD account with concurrent sessions originating from multiple unique IP addresses within a 5-minute window. It leverages Azure Active Directory NonInteractiveUserSignInLogs to identify this behavior by analyzing successful authentication events and counting distinct source IPs.
